question: List each building key and floor key within the department of facilities, the number of rooms, total area, average area per floor, building name, access level, zip code, and city. Include subtotals for each building and a grand total across all buildings. The subtotals and grand total should not include zip code or city. Numbers of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE space_detail AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  room_square_footage,
  room_counter,
  building_room,
  building_component
FROM beaver."SPACE_DETAIL"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE buildings AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  building_number,
  building_name,
  bldg_gross_square_footage,
  bldg_assignable_square_footage
FROM beaver."BUILDINGS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fac_building AS
SELECT 
  fac_building_key,
  building_number,
  building_name_long,
  access_level_code
FROM beaver."FAC_BUILDING"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fac_floor AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  floor,
  access_level,
  assignable_area
FROM beaver."FAC_FLOOR"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fac_rooms AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  room,
  area,
  access_level
FROM beaver."FAC_ROOMS"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "space_detail" AS SELECT building_key, floor_key, room_square_footage, room_counter, building_room, building_component FROM beaver."SPACE_DETAIL"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT building_key, building_number, building_name, bldg_gross_square_footage, bldg_assignable_square_footage FROM beaver."BUILDINGS"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_building" AS SELECT fac_building_key, building_number, building_name_long, access_level_code FROM beaver."FAC_BUILDING"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_floor" AS SELECT building_key, floor_key, floor, access_level, assignable_area FROM beaver."FAC_FLOOR"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_rooms" AS SELECT building_key, floor_key, room, area, access_level FROM beaver."FAC_ROOMS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "space_detail" AS SELECT 
  building_key AS building_key,
  floor_key AS floor_key,
  room_square_footage AS room_square_footage,
  room_counter AS room_counter,
  building_room AS building_room,
  building_component AS building_component
FROM beaver."SPACE_DETAIL"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT 
  building_key AS building_key,
  building_number AS building_number,
  building_name AS building_name,
  bldg_gross_square_footage AS bldg_gross_square_footage,
  bldg_assignable_square_footage AS bldg_assignable_square_footage
FROM beaver."BUILDINGS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_building" AS SELECT 
  fac_building_key AS fac_building_key,
  building_number AS building_number,
  building_name_long AS building_name_long,
  access_level_code AS access_level_code
FROM beaver."FAC_BUILDING"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_floor" AS SELECT 
  building_key AS building_key,
  floor_key AS floor_key,
  floor AS floor,
  access_level AS access_level,
  assignable_area AS assignable_area
FROM beaver."FAC_FLOOR"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "fac_rooms" AS SELECT 
  building_key AS building_key,
  floor_key AS floor_key,
  room AS room,
  area AS area,
  access_level AS access_level
FROM beaver."FAC_ROOMS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE per_floor AS
SELECT 
  sd.building_key,
  sd.floor_key,
  COUNT(*) AS rooms_cnt,
  SUM(sd.room_square_footage) AS area_sum
FROM space_detail sd
GROUP BY sd.building_key, sd.floor_key;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE per_floor_enriched AS
SELECT pf.building_key, pf.floor_key, pf.rooms_cnt, pf.area_sum,
       ff.floor,
       COALESCE(ff.access_level, NULL) AS floor_access_level
FROM per_floor pf
LEFT JOIN fac_floor ff
  ON pf.building_key = ff.building_key AND pf.floor_key = ff.floor_key;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE building_dim AS
SELECT 
  COALESCE(b.building_key, fb.fac_building_key) AS building_key,
  COALESCE(b.building_name, fb.building_name_long) AS building_name,
  fb.access_level_code AS building_access_level
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT building_key, building_name FROM buildings) b
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT fac_building_key, building_name_long, access_level_code FROM fac_building
) fb
ON b.building_key = fb.fac_building_key;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE detail_rows AS
SELECT 
  pfe.building_key,
  pfe.floor_key,
  pfe.rooms_cnt,
  pfe.area_sum,
  CASE WHEN pfe.rooms_cnt > 0 THEN pfe.area_sum / pfe.rooms_cnt ELSE NULL END AS avg_area_per_floor,
  bd.building_name,
  bd.building_access_level AS access_level,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS zip_code,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS city
FROM per_floor_enriched pfe
LEFT JOIN building_dim bd
  ON pfe.building_key = bd.building_key;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE subtotal_rows AS
SELECT 
  d.building_key,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS floor_key,
  SUM(d.rooms_cnt) AS rooms_cnt,
  SUM(d.area_sum) AS area_sum,
  CASE WHEN SUM(d.rooms_cnt) > 0 THEN SUM(d.area_sum) / SUM(d.rooms_cnt) ELSE NULL END AS avg_area_per_floor,
  d.building_name,
  d.access_level,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS zip_code,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS city
FROM detail_rows d
GROUP BY d.building_key, d.building_name, d.access_level;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE grand_total AS
SELECT 
  CAST('ALL' AS VARCHAR) AS building_key,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS floor_key,
  SUM(d.rooms_cnt) AS rooms_cnt,
  SUM(d.area_sum) AS area_sum,
  CASE WHEN SUM(d.rooms_cnt) > 0 THEN SUM(d.area_sum) / SUM(d.rooms_cnt) ELSE NULL END AS avg_area_per_floor,
  CAST('Grand Total' AS VARCHAR) AS building_name,
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS access_level,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS zip_code,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS city
FROM detail_rows d;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  FORMAT('%s', TO_CHAR(ROUND(rooms_cnt), 'FM999,999,999')) AS rooms,
  FORMAT('%s', TO_CHAR(ROUND(area_sum), 'FM999,999,999')) AS total_area,
  FORMAT('%s', TO_CHAR(ROUND(avg_area_per_floor), 'FM999,999,999')) AS avg_area_per_floor,
  building_name,
  access_level,
  zip_code,
  city
FROM unioned
ORDER BY building_key, floor_key NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(rooms_cnt) AS BIGINT)) AS rooms,
  printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(area_sum) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area,
  printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(avg_area_per_floor) AS BIGINT)) AS avg_area_per_floor,
  building_name,
  access_level,
  zip_code,
  city
FROM unioned
ORDER BY building_key, floor_key NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    building_key,
    floor_key,
    ROUND(rooms_cnt)::BIGINT AS rooms_i,
    ROUND(area_sum)::BIGINT AS total_area_i,
    ROUND(avg_area_per_floor)::BIGINT AS avg_area_i,
    building_name,
    access_level,
    zip_code,
    city
  FROM unioned
)
SELECT 
  building_key,
  floor_key,
  format('%', rooms_i, ',', '.') AS rooms,
  format('%', total_area_i, ',', '.') AS total_area,
  format('%', avg_area_i, ',', '.') AS avg_area_per_floor,
  building_name,
  access_level,
  CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE zip_code END AS zip_code,
  CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE city END AS city
FROM formatted
ORDER BY CASE WHEN building_key = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, building_key, floor_key NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    building_key,
    floor_key,
    CAST(ROUND(rooms_cnt) AS BIGINT) AS rooms_i,
    CAST(ROUND(area_sum) AS BIGINT) AS total_area_i,
    CAST(ROUND(avg_area_per_floor) AS BIGINT) AS avg_area_i,

SELECT

  printf('%''d', rooms_i) AS rooms,
  printf('%''d', total_area_i) AS total_area,
  printf('%''d', avg_area_i) AS avg_area_per_floor,
  building_name,
  access_level,
  CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE zip_code END AS zip_code,
  CASE WHEN floor_key IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE city END AS city
FROM formatted
ORDER BY CASE WHEN building_key = 'ALL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, building_key, floor_key NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH formatted AS (
  SELECT 
    building_key,

    CAST(ROUND(rooms_cnt) AS BIGINT) AS rooms_i,
    CAST(ROUND(area_sum) AS BIGINT) AS total_area_i,
